error[VIBE4004]: `>>>` is not supported in component styles.
  --> style/deprecated/input.vibe:7:4
7 | .a >>> .b { color: red; }
  |    ^^^
fix: Write `:deep(.child)` to style `.child` inside child components.
fix: Write `:global(.name)` for a rule that is not scoped.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE4004

error[VIBE4004]: `/deep/` is not supported in component styles.
  --> style/deprecated/input.vibe:8:4
8 | .a /deep/ .b { color: v-bind(color); }
  |    ^^^^^^
fix: Write `:deep(.child)` to style `.child` inside child components.
fix: Write `:global(.name)` for a rule that is not scoped.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE4004

error[VIBE4003]: `v-bind()` is not supported in component styles.
  --> style/deprecated/input.vibe:8:23
8 | .a /deep/ .b { color: v-bind(color); }
  |                       ^^^^^^
fix: Set a CSS custom property such as `--color` with `:style` in the template, and read it with `var(--color)`.
fix: Bind a class or style in the template with `:class` or `:style`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE4003

error[VIBE4004]: `::v-deep` is not supported in component styles.
  --> style/deprecated/input.vibe:9:1
9 | ::v-deep(.c), ::v-global(.d) { margin: 0; }
  | ^^^^^^^^
fix: Write `:deep(.child)` to style `.child` inside child components.
fix: Write `:global(.name)` for a rule that is not scoped.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE4004

error[VIBE4004]: `::v-global` is not supported in component styles.
  --> style/deprecated/input.vibe:9:15
9 | ::v-deep(.c), ::v-global(.d) { margin: 0; }
  |               ^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Write `:deep(.child)` to style `.child` inside child components.
fix: Write `:global(.name)` for a rule that is not scoped.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE4004

error[VIBE4002]: `:slotted` is not supported in component styles.
  --> style/deprecated/input.vibe:10:1
10 | :slotted(.e), ::v-slotted(.f) { padding: 0; }
   | ^^^^^^^^
fix: Style the slot content in the `<style scoped>` block of the component that passes it.
fix: Wrap the selector in `:global()` to write a global rule.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE4002

   |               ^^^^^^^^^^^

fix: Wrap the selector in `:global()` to write a global rule.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE4002
